artifacts.summary: Confirms task 396 already settled phase-commit gating (full lake build mandatory at every Lean phase-end, not only the final phase); recommends the tier mapping treat full as the sole phase-end-gating tier for Lean while prose/local/interface cover in-phase, non-gating verification density; flags task 412's own file_scope naming a hard-mode agent file deleted on 2026-11-09, and flags the dispatch's 'build-enabled mode' phrase as unverifiable from this source store.

memory_candidates.content: In this agent-system source store, --hard no longer dispatches a separate *-hard-agent.md file (those were deleted 2026-11-09, commit 749c660a4, task 444's hard-mode consolidation). Hard-mode contracts are now injected into the SAME standard agent file at dispatch time. A task's file_scope or description referencing a *-hard-agent.md path for lean/cslib/etc. predates this change and should be corrected rather than targeted.

core's suite_selection_select (scripts/lib/suite-selection-lib.sh) has zero mappings for .lean paths, so a Lean-only phase's Tier Justification always resolves to the __FULL_SWEEP__ sentinel under core's generic mechanism even though .lean files do have elaboration surface. plan-format.md's own 'Unmappable criterion' paragraph (Batch-aware deferral section) sanctions a domain extension defining its own concrete covering-check actions in this situation rather than relying on the generic shell-suite narrowing.
